ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white dominant in central lobe regions; low-intensity black contiguous margins along the entire trailing edge; dense black pixel mottling concentrated around the median notch and extending into vertical streaks on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 58 degrees relative to lobe horizontal axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3-12 pixels visible along the boundary of both lobes against the background gradient.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex sweep transitioning to an S-curve concavity as the trailing edge approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and along the upper trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible: vertical orientation on the medial-left lobe and diagonal orientation on the distal-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor pixel-level discontinuities and small indentations along the trailing edge boundary consistent with natural wear or past micro-trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetrical pigmentation pattern with a heavy dark 'blotch' cluster located immediately to the left of the median notch.
